claim: C1-seed: under one fixed token-noise stream per seed, temperature changes the algorithm (idea) almost never while plan noise at the task-spec states (blocks 12-23, prefill only) changes it in a substantial share of seeds; temperature changes phrasings.

model.hf_engine: exp17 FP8 W8A8 (per-output-channel weight / per-token activation scales; lm_head, embeddings, norms bf16) on the 16 GB RTX 2000 Ada (the screen's card)

seeds.definition: slot (task, w, k), w in W1-W5, k in 0-3 (20 per task); the screen's NEUTRAL slot keys; uniforms u_stream(task, w, k, n = max_new) (PCG64 prefix property: the 1,536 stream extends the 1,024 one)

couplings.thinking_off_primary: inverse-CDF in vocabulary order (float64 CDF, one PCG64 uniform per row and step, prune=False, fixed batch shape B per task)
couplings.thinking_on: vLLM exponential race (Gumbel-max) with per-request seed stable_seed(task,w,k)
couplings.gumbel_replicate_iii: HF exponential race with per-row CUDA generator seeded stable_seed(task, w, k, 'gumbel'), step-indexed
couplings.caveat: off/on change counts use different couplings; every count is labelled with its coupling; arm (iii) reruns the T2/T03 NO-PN block and the alpha-1 T1.0 PN block under Gumbel-max

conditions_thinking_off.filler_repeats: G_clean, T1.0, slots k 0-3, different batch-mates (noise floor)

T03_unit_ratio_exp17_over_exp13.deviation: max relative difference > 1e-4: exp17 recomputed the T03 unit under FP8 from its own ban/twin prompts; the 2x2 uses the protocol-v4 unit (exp13), so alpha 1 on T03 here is about 1/ratio of the screen's alpha-1 push

hook: exp17 make_edits('RAND', u = D_d, alpha): h <- h + (alpha n[l,p] - (h - h_twin_clean).u) u on block outputs 12-23, positions S = [p1, spec_end), fp32, prefill only; h_twin_clean from the clean twin prefill of the same template
batch_rule: B per task = largest of {20, 10, 5} with B * (P + max_new + 1) * 147,456 <= 0.85 * free VRAM after loading; constant across all of that task's arms
layout_rule: per (task, template): 120 rows (NOPN 20, PN 96, filler 4); tier 0 = NOPN + alpha-1 PN + filler, tier 1 = alpha-2 PN; within a tier rows are sorted by (temperature descending, group, slot) and cut into batches of B; filler rows are placed after their originals so each repeat has different batch-mates (deterministic = committed permutation); tier 1 runs last

labels.modes: catalogue modes + 'other'; 'invalid' (no code, syntax error, crash before the first traced op) and 'unresolved' (incl. 'disputed') excluded from change counting
labels.primary_population: VALID programs (attempted ideas); correct-only is the sensitivity

definitions.changed_T: 1 if the seed's valid labels over {NOPN T0.3, T0.7, T1.0, T1.3} contain >= 2 distinct values (>= 2 valid labels required, else not countable)
definitions.changed_PN: same over {NOPN at T} + {PN(d, alpha, T) for d in S}
definitions.C_T: sum of changed_T over countable seeds (n reported)
definitions.C_PN: mean over all C(6,3) = 20 subsets S of sum_s changed_PN(s; S)
definitions.x_s: (mean over countable subsets of changed_PN(s; alpha 1, T1.0)) - changed_T(s)

thresholds.H-T: C_T <= 1 of 20 in each of 4 cells: T1, T2, T03 thinking off; T2 thinking on (seeds complete at all 4 temperatures, n reported)
thresholds.H-PN: C_PN(alpha 1, T 1.0) >= 5 of 20 on T2 AND on T03
thresholds.H-PHR: pooled slope of log(PPI) on T > 0 with the 95% seed-bootstrap CI excluding 0, at every theta in {0.7, 0.8, 0.9}
thresholds.H-CON: one-sided sign-flip permutation p < 0.05 for mean x_s > 0, pooled over T2 and T03 (40 seeds); 100,000 draws; the artifact's single entry to the iteration's secondary Holm family (C1-seed)

outcomes.CONFIRMED: H-T and H-PN and H-PHR and H-CON
outcomes.DISCONFIRMED: pooled mean x_s <= 0, or C_T >= C_PN(alpha 1, T1.0) on both T2 and T03
outcomes.PARTIAL: anything else, naming the part that failed (e.g. 'temperature inert but PN weaker than predicted' when H-T holds and C_PN in [1, 4])

descriptive_expectations.hill1_PN_a1_T0.7_vs_TOPK10: Hill-1(PN alpha 1, T0.7, depth 20) > Hill-1(TOPK10 at T0.7) on T03 and T2
descriptive_expectations.interaction: under escaping directions, T0.7 vs T1.0 changes the label in more seeds than under no PN
descriptive_expectations.optional_ii: the first approach named moves in >= 3 of 10 seeds for at least one direction

phrasing.shingles: ast.parse; docstrings dropped (comments never reach the AST); identifiers renamed in first-appearance order; constants -> type; pre-order node types + operators + attribute names; 4-grams; Jaccard
phrasing.clusters: connected components at Jaccard >= theta within each (condition, idea); complete linkage as robustness
phrasing.rarefaction: PN cells rarefied to depth 20 by drawing one direction per seed (1,000 draws)
phrasing.slope: OLS slope of log PPI on T per task over the 4 NOPN cells; seed bootstrap 2,000 reps (each seed's coupled programs resampled together); pooled = mean of task slopes

thinking_on.repeat: T0.7 x 20 seeds, reverse order, interleaved
thinking_on.primary: seeds complete at all 4 temperatures; forced-close labels as sensitivity

ii.what: PN with thinking on, T2, 10 seeds (W1-W5 x k 0-1) x {no PN, 3 directions at alpha 2.0}, T 0.7, max_new 2048
ii.selection_rule: the 3 of the 6 directions with the highest alpha-2 T0.7 off-default share on T2 (thinking off, this 2x2); ties broken by seed

optional_arms.iii: Gumbel-max replicate on T2 and T03: NOPN x 4 T x 20 seeds + PN alpha 1 T1.0 x 6 x 20
optional_arms.iv: min-p extended dial: NOPN T2.0, min-p 0.1, 20 seeds x 3 tasks
optional_arms.i: T1 thinking on (vLLM), only if >= 1.5 h of wall clock remain

never_drop: alpha-1 PN block on T2 and T03

engine_check.T03: per template one 20-row batch: NEUTRAL k 0-9 + RAND9002 alpha 1 k 0-9 (exp17 unit)
engine_check.T2: NEUTRAL k 0-9 + RAND9004 alpha 1 k 0-9 at the task's B
engine_check.verdict_rule: REPRODUCED if JS(this run, screen) <= the template-resampling null p95 for all four compositions, else PRECISION-SENSITIVE (logged addendum, no threshold change)

power_expectation.method: 20,000 MC reps; 6 directions with replacement from the task's screen directions; p_d = max(0, excess); landing labels from each direction's off-default distribution; NOPN off-default w.p. the twin share

T03_a1.0_unit_adjusted_linear_dose.note: p_d scaled by 1/ratio (alpha 1 here ~ alpha 1/ratio at the screen's unit; linear dose)

T03_a1.0_exp13_protocol_unit_pool.note: pool = exp13 rand1-3 (bf16, protocol-v4 unit, alpha 1), 3 directions

temperature.source: exp12 same-seed CRN: 0/30 seeds changed in 10 of 12 cells (rate 1/30 used as the stated prior)

power_expectation.note: No design change follows: more directions only shrink the lottery variance, they do not raise E[C_PN]. The T03 rows are optimistic: the screen used exp17's T03 unit, ~1.32x the protocol-v4 unit used here.

multiplicity: one p-value (H-CON pooled sign-flip) enters the iteration's secondary Holm family as C1-seed
